name: week
title: This week at the clinic
subtitle: What needs attention, the appointment book and the trials. Rendered by npm run view.

sections.title: Needs attention
sections.note: Appointments with a problem, trials ending, clients tested and not fitted, reviews due, repairs, claims and accounts.
sections.sql: select kind,record,due,detail from v_attention order by due nulls last,kind,record

sections.title: Appointment book
sections.sql: select code,on_date as day,starts,minutes,kind,client,name,clinician,clinic,problems from v_schedule where status='booked' and on_date between current_date and current_date+6 order by on_date,starts

sections.title: Hearing aids on trial
sections.sql: select code,client,name,model,ear,fitted_on,trial_ends,trial_days_left,follow_up,clinician from v_trials order by trial_ends

name: growth
title: Fittings and recalls
subtitle: Where the next fittings come from: tested and not fitted, reviews due, clients due new aids.

sections.title: Tested, not fitted
sections.sql: select client,name,tested_on,days_since,better_4fa,clinician,funder,next_booked from v_unfitted order by days_since desc

sections.title: Due new hearing aids
sections.sql: select code,name,funder,models,oldest_kept,eligible_from,next_booked from v_upgrades order by eligible_from

sections.title: Reviews due, nothing booked
sections.sql: select code,name,clinic,funder,last_test,due_on,devices from v_recalls order by due_on nulls first

sections.title: Clinicians, last 180 days
sections.sql: select code,name,tests,fit_recommended,aids_fitted,kept,returned,kept_value,tested_not_fitted from v_clinician_results order by kept_value desc

sections.title: Referral sources
sections.sql: select source,clients,tested,fitted,device_revenue from v_referrals order by device_revenue desc

name: compliance
title: Compliance
subtitle: Every rule in docs/compliance.md checked against the records.

sections.title: Findings
sections.sql: select rule,record,issue from v_compliance order by rule,record

sections.title: Claims
sections.sql: select code,client,funder,item,service_on,amount,state,days_waiting from v_claims where state<>'paid' order by service_on

sections.title: Clinician registrations
sections.sql: select code,name,role,registration_no,registration_expiry,hsp_qualified from clinicians where active order by registration_expiry
